同一会话目标选择为读、动作和上传复用。浏览器配对、应用连接器审批及操作自身的授权是不同阶段。
[Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 显示，组件把已有页面、用户引用和工具执行连进同一会话。
[Q02](#research-q02) 与 [Q03](#research-q03) 指出，目标授权不能替代对上传去向与连接器动作的核查；超时后需独立确认效果。
[Q04](#research-q04) 的待验证假设是，持续复用同一标签能减少人工定位和复制；若目标核对增加的时间抵消节省，则放弃假设。

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 的本地桥和扩展属于已有机制适配，新增性四分之一。绑定到会话引用并筛选上传路径改变目标控制，机制半档。可迁移到有会话和扩展入口的宿主，迁移半档。减少复制但增加配对，简化四分之一。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 对话内保留页面定位，流程半档。最终仍需核对原网页，交付局部变化。免另写脚本降低部分门槛，触达四分之一。[Q04](#research-q04) 待测配置对比，经济性小幅。

recommendation.reason: 能使用专用浏览器 profile 的 DSH 用户，可以先让插件读取一个已明确选中的无敏感测试标签。与手工打开标签并复制相比，插件会在当前会话保留目标并通过配对扩展读取页面。若读到别的标签、未授权会话也能读取或桥接失控，就断开扩展并回到手工浏览。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的 host.js 263–285 对应重复定位已打开标签，超过偶发便利；真实需求未测，低于满档。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 的 host.js 151–175 支持会话目标控制，超过入口包装；人工可低成本确认目标，取半档。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 查到 bridge.js 73–113 与工具调用的绑定，超过声明级；未执行浏览器、连接器或宿主，止于源码档。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 可断开桥、回到手工路径，超过难以退出档；需要配对和独立账号环境，低于较轻负担。

If the registry returns `404`, use the local installation below. Mirrors may take time to sync a newly published version. ### Build and Install Locally ```sh git clone --branch ver0.2.3 https://github.com/SheepofSheep/dsh-doyourweb.git cd dsh-doyourweb npm ci npm run build ``` In DSH, open **Plugins > Add Plugin** and enter the **absolute path to this built project directory**. The bridge starts when the plugin activates. No separate development server is required. ### Connect the Browser First install and enable `dsh-doyourweb` in DSH **Plugins > Add plugin**, then connect the companion browser extension, then reference a page in chat. These are separate steps; installing the plugin does not install or pair the extension. Once enabled, **Browser** in the left navigation opens the page panel; **Connection settings** opens pairing. Alternatively, type `/browser` in the composer and select **Browser**. The `@` menu should offer the browser setup candidate even before the extension is installed or connected. After pairing, use the panel or `@page title` to reference a page. If both the navigation entry and `/browser` candidate are missing, check that the plugin is installed and enabled, fully quit DSH including the system tray, then restart. If still missing, report the full DSH build, plugin version, missing entry location and loading errors. If the entry shows **Not connected**, open setup and follow the pairing steps below. For **Service unavailable**, inspect plugin loading errors and the local bridge service before retrying pairing. 1. Enter `/browser` in DSH and open the local connection page. 2. Open `edge://extensions` or `chrome://extensions`, enable developer mode, and load the project's `extension/` folder as an unpacked extension. 3. ## 06 · Structure and Technical Details ```text src/ host.js Plugin lifecycle, tools and conversation context client.js Native mention and slash-menu sources client-entry.js React UI and icons bridge.js Pairing, extension connection and CDP relay engine.js Snapshots, actions, extraction and screenshots annotations.js Isolated element picker and acknowledged chat drafts apps/ App inventory, discovery, approval, installation and execution manage.js Local application and connector management UI webmcp.js Site-tool discovery, routing, validation and calls grants.js Conversation-scoped tab authorization protocol.js Tab references and Remote RPC descriptors output.js Serialized output budgeting vendor/ Adapted Playwright browser model extension/ Manifest V3 extension and popup scripts/ Build, integration and compatibility checks test/ Unit tests and fixtures docs/setup-page.png Pairing-page screenshot cordis.patch.yml DSH plugin registration and defaults lib/ Generated build output, not tracked in Git ``` **Snapshots and actions.** Full snapshot text is cached locally for pagination. Element references require a current snapshot; reads, actions and navigation can invalidate previous references. Calls are serialized per tab. Cancellation reports completed or uncertain steps rather than promising rollback. **Connection lifetime.** Idle connections detach the debugger without closing the tab. A later read reconnects. Restarting the browser changes tab-reference sessions, so select the page again with `@`. **Data handling.** Pairing credentials and authorization records live in the local data directory; screenshots are stored under `captures/`. Referenced page excerpts enter DSH's model context and may be sent to your configured model provider. Keep pairing files and screenshots private. Purchases, destructive actions and sensitive submissions require explicit user authorization; the plugin does not provide a separate transaction-confirmation dialog.
Development checks ```sh npm run build npm test npx playwright-core install chromium npm run test:browser npm run verify:dsh -- --asar "" ``` CI is configured for unit tests on Windows and Linux, plus isolated headless Chromium integration on Linux. The badge links to the actual workflow result. Headless checks do not replace end-to-end validation of a daily browser profile and the native DSH UI.
